text: Managing a team is not always easy, but good leaders use several key skills to succeed. First, clear communication helps everyone understand their tasks and goals. Second, delegation is important because a leader cannot do everything alone. Trusting team members with responsibilities also makes them feel valued. Third, giving regular feedback helps people improve and stay on track. Motivation matters too, so managers should recognise good work and encourage their team. Finally, when disagreements happen, a leader must solve conflicts fairly and calmly. By combining these skills, managers can build a strong, happy, and productive team.
